role: Engineering reading of original synthetic AI outputs, not independent legal review
reviewed_accepted_answer_range: RD31_001 through RD31_085; RD31_086 through RD31_100 are intended outside-scope routes

findings.issue: Language, anaphora, explicit concern-boundary or domain-recognition errors
findings.repair: Scoped context/segmentation features with counterexamples; no new training questions or threshold relaxation

findings.issue: Relevant-source focus or incompatible remedy regime
findings.repair: Query-relevance focus for probation, price comparisons, price display, product safety and pay frequency

findings.issue: Limited excerpt overclaims or actor/condition errors passed automated support
findings.repair: Source-reading notes and deterministic source-bound qualification checks with positive controls

findings.issue: Ambiguous actor, awkward remedy translation, overbroad only condition, or omitted/changed qualification
findings.repair: Preserve literal ambiguous wording and emphasize actor directions, alternatives and source conditions; final outputs require review; no legal approval claimed

findings.issue: Internal quote-selection labels appeared in prose
findings.repair: Remove only isolated trailing transport-label lists; reject labels left inside prose

findings.issue: Outer request timeout discarded the entire result
findings.repair: Stop provider work before the outer deadline and reserve time for a readable fallback; avoid a revision when too little time remains

unresolved_external_acceptance: Owner acceptance under live demonstration conditions
